lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Hello, Mama. I am... very busy here. Dubai is... very good. I have a big job now. Everything is fine.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: ...Do not worry about me. I am making it.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Macal? Dune and Company. We need to talk about your contract. Are you there?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Sorry, can you repeat that? I... I am not sure I understand.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَهْلًا بِيكُمْ يا جَماعَة، أَنا مَحْمُود، وَمَعاكُمْ Yalla Fluent! النَّهارْدَه، مَعانا ماكال، شابّ مِصْري، عايِشْ في دُبَيْ، وَعِنْدُه حِكايَة كِبيرَة... وَأَوَّلْ مُشْكِلَة: بِيِكْدِبْ عَلى أُمُّه!
lines.direction: warm, playful welcome, grin in the voice

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: خُدْ بالَكْ مِنْ تَلاتَة تَعْبيرات... لَمّا تِسْمَعْهُمْ، رَكِّزْ كِوَيِّس: Hello, I am Macal... Sorry, can you repeat that?... وَ Can you speak slowly, please?
lines.direction: focused, counting on fingers, slow on the English phrases

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: التَّعْبيرات دِي هِيَّ مِفْتاحْ أَوَّلْ خُطْوَة... التَّعْريفْ بِنَفْسَكْ، وَطَلَبْ التَّكْرارْ بِلُطْفْ. يَلّا، نِسْمَعْ ماكال... وَخُدْ بالَكْ مِنْ كُلْ كِلْمَة!
lines.direction: encouraging, building energy toward the scene

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Okay. Okay. I finish the voice note. I send it now... before I change my mind.
lines.direction: nervous, talking to himself, quick breaths

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Hello, Mama. I hope you are well. I am... I am fine. Work is good. Everything is good. Do not worry.
lines.direction: recording, forcing a smile, slow and careful

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: ...Send. Okay. She will be happy. She does not need to know about the meeting today.
lines.direction: quiet, guilty, exhale at the end

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Macal? This is Dune and Company. We need to talk about your contract today. Are you free at four?
lines.direction: professional, brisk but polite, Gulf-Indian English

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Sorry, can you repeat that? The line is... not very clear. You said four o'clock?
lines.direction: panicked but polite, stalling for time

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Yes. Four o'clock. With Mr. Tarek and the team. It is about your contract renewal.
lines.direction: calm, repeating clearly, slight smile in voice

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: ...Okay. Yes. I will be there. Thank you. Thank you very much. Goodbye.
lines.direction: voice drops, hand trembling, hanging up fast

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Four o'clock. Tarek will be there. Tarek speaks English like... like it is his first language. And me? I live here since two years and I still say 'Sorry, can you repeat that?'
lines.direction: bitter, self-mocking, then a long pause

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: ...No. Stop. I am Macal. I am from Egypt. I am in Dubai. I can do this. I have ninety days. I just... need to speak better. Tonight.
lines.direction: fired up, quiet determination, then a shaky breath

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيِّبْ يا جَماعَة... كِدَه إِحْنا سِمِعْنا ماكال وَهُوَ بِيِتْكَلِّمْ. تَعالُوا نْفَكِّكْ تَلاتَة تَعْبيرات، وَواحِدْ غَلْطَة كِتيرْ مِنَّا بِنِعْمِلْها.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَوَّلْ تَعْبير: Hello, I am Macal... يَعْنِي أَهْلًا، أَنا ماكال. بِنْقُولْها لَمّا نْقابِلْ حَدْ أَوَّلْ مَرَّة. مَثَلًا: Hello, I am Macal. Nice to meet you!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: تَانِي تَعْبير: Sorry, can you repeat that?... يَعْنِي آسِفْ، تِقْدَرْ تُكَرَّرْ؟ وِلَمّا الخَطْ مِشْ واضِحْ أَوْ الكَلامْ سَريعْ... بِنْقُولْها بِأَدَبْ. مَثَلًا: Sorry, can you repeat that, please?

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَتَالِتْ تَعْبير: Can you speak slowly, please?... يَعْنِي مُمْكِنْ تِتْكَلَّمْ بِبُطُءْ، لَوْ سَمَحْتْ. السُّؤالْ دَهْ قُوَّة، مِشْ ضَعْفْ!
lines.direction: confident, reassuring, slight emphasis on strength

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيِّبْ... وَدِي أَكْبَرْ غَلْطَة: ماكال قال I live here since two years. الأَصْلْ: في العَرَبِي بِنْقُولْ مِنْ سَنِتين... فَالعَقْلْ بِيِتْرْجِمْها حَرْفِي وَيِحُطْ since. الصَّحْ: I have lived here for two years. يَعْنِي بِنِسْتَخْدِمْ فِيهِ for مَعَ المُدَّةْ، مِشْ since.
lines.direction: patient, corrective but kind, slowing down on the natural form

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: مِتْخافِشْ لَوْ غَلَطْتْ... الغَلَطْ دَهْ طَبيعي، وَإِحْنا هِنِتْعَلِّمْ مَعَ بَعْضْ. يَلّا، نِرْجَعْ لِلْحِكايَة... مَعْ ماكال، وَالأَرْبَعَة بَالظَّبْطْ!
lines.direction: warm, motivating, building momentum back to the story

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Okay. Four o'clock. I am ready. I have lived here for two years. I can do this.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Macal! You are early. That is a good sign. Are you okay? You look... far away.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Hello, Nour. I am okay. Just a little nervous. There is a meeting about my contract today.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Your contract? Macal, that is big. Listen, you are good at your job. Just be yourself in there.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Thank you. That means a lot. I have lived here for two years, but sometimes I still feel new.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Two years or two days, you belong here. Hey, I have to run. Good luck today, okay? Text me after!

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I will. Goodbye, Nour. ...Okay. I can do this. I have lived here for two years. I am ready.
lines.direction: determined, then a beat of doubt

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Macal, good, you are here. Before the meeting, one more thing. We need a two-minute video from you. About your journey. By Friday.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: A video? By Friday? Sorry, can you repeat that, please? Two minutes... about me?

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Yes. Two minutes. In English. Friday. The team will watch it. See you inside.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: ...Friday. In English. Two minutes. Okay. Okay. I am Macal. I can do this.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيِّبْ يا جَماعَة... إِحْنا اتْعَلَّمْنا النَّهارْدَهْ تَلاتَة تَعْبيرات، وَكُلْ واحِدْ مِنَّهُمْ هَيِفْتَحْلَكْ بابْ. الأَوَّلْ: Hello, I am Macal. وَالتَّانِي: Sorry, can you repeat that, please? وَالتَّالِتْ: Can you speak slowly, please?
lines.direction: warm recap, steady rhythm, smile in voice

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَعِبَارَة الحَلْقَة... خُدْها مَعاكْ: Sorry, can you repeat that, please? الجُمْلَة دِي مِشْ ضَعْفْ... دِي ذَكاءْ! لَمّا تِسْتَخْدِمْها، إِنْتَ بِتَقُولْ: أَنا مُحْتَرِمْ، وَعايِزْ أَفْهَمْ صَحْ.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَمِتْنَساوِشْ: I have lived here for two years... for مَعَ المُدَّةْ، مِشْ since. تَمارَنْوا دِي كامْ مَرَّة في اليَوْمْ، وَهَتْلاقُوا الفَرْقْ.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: قَبْلْ ما نِسْكَرْ، تَعالُوا عَلى تِلِجرام بْتاعْ Yalla Fluent... هَتْلاقُوا المَشاهِدْ كامْلة، وَتَدْرِيباتْ سَهْلة، وَإِنْتَ كَمانْ تِتْكَلَّمْ مَعانا. اِشْتَرِكْ في البودكاست، وَخَلِّي أَصْحابَكْ يِعْرَفُوا... التَّعَلُّمْ بِالمَرَحْ!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَفِي الحَلْقَة الجايَة... ماكال هَيِسَجِّلْ الفِيدْيو، وَرُبْع ساعَة قَبْلْ الدِيدْلايِن... هَنِشُوفْ هَلْ يِقْدَرْ يِتْكَلَّمْ، وَلّا الخَوْفْ هَيِكْسَبْ؟ يَلّا... نِلْتَقِي قَرِيبْ!
